variants.title: Hooke's law: k of a 0.6 mm music wire spring
variants.sample: Music wire spring: wire 0.6 mm, mean coil diameter 24 mm, 20 active turns
variants.unknown: the spring constant k of a 0.6 mm music wire spring
variants.note: For music wire (ASTM A228), G = 81.7 GPa, so k = G d⁴ / (8 D³ N) = 4.8 N/m. You measure k; the formula is only the maker's estimate.

source.title: Shigley's Mechanical Engineering Design (Budynas, Nisbett), Table 10-5: shear modulus G of spring wires; k = G d⁴ / (8 D³ N)
